target.title: Fix QMD vector search timeout defaults
target.body:
﻿## What Problem This Solves

Addresses QMD memory search/embed reliability from #74204 by making two slow-path defaults safer for CPU-only or otherwise constrained hosts:

- Raises the default `memory.qmd.update.embedTimeoutMs` from 120s to 600s so normal embedding jobs are not killed before they can complete on slower hardware.
- Stops direct CLI `searchMode: "vsearch"` from invoking raw `qmd vsearch`; it now uses the structured `qmd query "vec: ..." --json --no-rerank` form instead.
- Accepts both legacy array JSON and newer `{ "results": [...] }` query output shapes, including noisy wrapper output.

This augments the timeout-only approach in #87572 with the direct-search workaround we have been using operationally for vector searches.

## Scope / Non-goals

This is not a full QMD performance or CPU-saturation fix. It does not reduce the embedding workload, optimize QMD embeddings, add backpressure/scheduling, or prevent CPU-only hosts from spending substantial time on large embed jobs.

The PR should be read as a fix for OpenClaw's too-low embed timeout default plus the fragile direct CLI vector-search path. It may reduce false failures and improve vector-search reliability, but it should not by itself close broader QMD CPU saturation or embedding-performance issues.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing 120s embed default is too tight for CPU-bound embedding work. Separately, the raw `qmd vsearch` path is more fragile than QMD's typed `query` syntax: hyphenated semantic terms can be interpreted poorly, reranking can add unnecessary latency, and newer QMD query responses may be object-shaped rather than a bare array.

The direct CLI path already had nearby support for `query` and `--no-rerank`; this applies the same idea to vector-only searches and keeps lexical searches unchanged.

## User Impact

Users with QMD enabled should see fewer false embed timeouts and more reliable vector-only memory searches, especially on small VPS/CPU-only deployments. Existing lexical `search` behavior remains unchanged, and explicit user-configured timeouts still override the default.

## Evidence

- Added parser coverage for `{ "results": [...] }` QMD output and noisy object output.
- Added direct CLI coverage showing `searchMode: "vsearch"` invokes `qmd query "vec: ..." --json -n <limit> --no-rerank -c <collection>` and does not call raw `qmd vsearch`.
- Updated backend-config tests for the 600000ms default.
- Ran `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/qmd-query-parser.test.ts`: passed, 10 tests.
- Broader Windows local verification was blocked by environment noise: `backend-config.test.ts` hit Windows symlink `EPERM`, and filtered large test-file runs hung after dependency cleanup. Live VPS smoke is pending authenticated SSH access, so this is intentionally opened as a draft PR.
